title: A Single-Loop Regularized Newton Method for Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: For smooth nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax problems, existing second-order methods share a common double-loop structure where the inner maximization is solved to sufficiently high accuracy before each second-order step. First-order methods are often adopted in the inner loops for scalability, but they also undermine the condition-insensitivity of second-order methods, limiting these methods to instances with mild conditioning.
